description.en: Ray diagram showing incident ray, refracted ray, emergent ray, and the angle of deviation (δ).
description.hi: आपतित किरण, अपवर्तित किरण, निर्गत किरण और विचलन कोण (δ) को दर्शाने वाला किरण आरेख।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 350" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <g transform="translate(100, 250)">
    <!-- Prism Triangle -->
    <polygon points="0,0 300,0 150,-200" fill="#e0f2fe" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="3" />
    <text x="145" y="-210" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold">A</text>

    <!-- Incident Ray -->
    <line x1="-50" y1="-50" x2="75" y2="-100" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" />
    <path d="M -12 -65 L -10 -55 L 5 -75 Z" fill="#ef4444" />
    <text x="-40" y="-60" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#ef4444">Incident Ray</text>

    <!-- Normal 1 -->
    <line x1="30" y1="-65" x2="120" y2="-135" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
    <text x="40" y="-85" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">i</text>

    <!-- Refracted Ray (Inside Prism) -->
    <line x1="75" y1="-100" x2="225" y2="-100" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Normal 2 -->
    <line x1="270" y1="-65" x2="180" y2="-135" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
    <text x="245" y="-85" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">e</text>

    <!-- Emergent Ray -->
    <line x1="225" y1="-100" x2="350" y2="-50" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" />
    <path d="M 295 -72 L 285 -65 L 310 -55 Z" fill="#ef4444" />
    <text x="280" y="-40" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#ef4444">Emergent Ray</text>

    <!-- Extrapolated lines for Deviation -->
    <line x1="75" y1="-100" x2="150" y2="-130" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3,3" />
    <line x1="225" y1="-100" x2="150" y2="-130" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3,3" />
    
    <!-- Angle of Deviation Delta -->
    <text x="145" y="-140" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#f59e0b">δ</text>
  </g>
</svg>
